name: ZOO_BROWN_FINGERBOARD
notes: Brown tourist fingerboard 150 high (500 min to 1200 max long): chain 100|ZOO|70|90|20 = 100+245.2+70+90+20 = 525. ZOO 100 D white vertically centred. Chevron from the 25-grid detail: 90 wide, 100 high (centred, 25 margins), V run 35 (so the band is 55 thick horizontally).
